## Setup

### Packages

```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
tidyverse_packages()
```

## Importing data

```{r}
read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")
```

```{r}
penguins <- read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")
```

```{r}
penguins |> head()
penguins |> tail()
penguins |> View()
penguins |> summary()
penguins |> colnames()
penguins |> dim()
```

```{r}
penguins |> # Start with the penguin and THEN
    na.omit() |> # Remove the NAs and THEN
    arrange(bill_len) |> # Arrange(sort) the rows and THEN
    head() # Keep just the head (top 6 rows)
```


```{r}
library(heatmap)
penguins2 <- read_csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv")
penguins |> mean(flipper_len)
my_variable <- 0983
my_variable
```


```{r}
penguins |> glimpse()
penguins |> count(island)
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, 
       mapping = aes(x = bill_len,
                     y = bill_dep,
                     colour = sex,
                     shape = island)) +
  geom_point()
```
